## Analysis overview

Selects the derived NPI-X total-mean parameter, derives change from baseline, summarizes baseline and the mean Weeks 4–24 endpoint, and runs the efficacy model.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSNPIX`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: NPTOTMN parameter
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `BASE`: baseline value
- `CHG`: derived change from baseline
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number, including endpoint 98
- `EFFFL/ITTFL`: population flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
